items.title: Failure of associated points to lie in an open subscheme persists over a dense open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism over an irreducible base and a finitely type module, if the associated points of the generic fibre are not contained in a given open, then the same failure holds for every fibre over a nonempty open. The proof argues through the closures of the associated points outside the open, spreads those closures to a neighbourhood using finite type and irreducibility, and shows the traces still avoid the open fibrewise. Keeping the spread closures outside the open is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 6923-6938.
